## States

1. `planned`: no gate record proves anything yet
2. `parsed`: the frontend read the source without an error
3. `lifted`: the source became IR that passed the verifier
4. `recognized`: at least one pattern was recognized (optional)
5. `proved`: every applied rewrite has an accepted proof class (optional)
6. `legalized`: the IR is legal for the target
7. `emitted`: the target code was written
8. `compiled`: the target code was built
9. `executed`: the target code ran
10. `verified`: the target code agreed with an independent oracle
11. `performance-validated`: the target code met its benchmark
